title: The Last Train
logline: Two strangers share a train car as the world ends outside.

scene.setting: A dim, swaying night train between cities. Rain streaks the windows.
scene.premise: News just broke that this is the last train out. Neither knows if it leads anywhere safe.
scene.opening_beat: MARA is already seated when JONAS stumbles in, out of breath, and drops into the opposite seat.

constraints.objective: Reveal why each of them really got on this train.
constraints.end_condition: The train arrives, or one of them decides to get off.

cast.name: MARA
cast.character_brief: Late 40s, ex-paramedic, guarded, speaks in short clipped lines. Believes preparation beats hope.
cast.voice_notes: Terse. Rarely asks questions. Deflects with dry observations.

cast.name: JONAS
cast.character_brief: Mid-20s, over-caffeinated grad student, talks to fill silence, secretly terrified.
